name: Haji Shariatullah
role: Founder of the Faraizi reform movement
contribution: He initiated the Faraizi movement in Bengal, mobilizing rural Muslims around religious reform and social discipline.
context: In early 19th-century colonial Bengal, his movement emerged amid agrarian pressure, social hierarchy, and changing authority structures.
impact: He became a foundational figure in Muslim social reform and grassroots mobilization in Bengal.
highlight: He transformed religious reform into organized rural social action.
seoTitle: Haji Shariatullah: Founder of the Faraizi Movement
seoDescription: Learn about Haji Shariatullah's religious reform movement, rural organization, and the agrarian context of nineteenth-century Bengal.
shortAnswer: Haji Shariatullah founded the Faraizi movement, a major Muslim reform and rural mobilization movement in Bengal.
